title: ARBITER rulepack
description: Structural schema for a rulepack YAML file (rulepacks/amex/*.yaml). Validated by arbiter.rulepack.validate at load time; this file documents the same contract for humans and external tooling (e.g. a rulepack-authoring linter in CI).

rulepack_id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. 'amex-F29-v1'. Not the content hash -- RulePack.content_hash() is computed over the parsed structure at load time, so this field can stay stable across content changes if desired.

reason_code.description: The Amex/network reason code this rulepack adjudicates, e.g. 'F29'.

predicate_schema.description: The full universe of EDB (evidence-derived) predicate names this rulepack's rules reference. Used for missing_predicates / completeness reporting -- every predicate referenced by a rule body should appear here (arbiter.rulepack.validate enforces this).

predicates.description: Optional per-predicate metadata (C2: provenance tier gating). If omitted, tier gating for that predicate is not enforced at derivation and it may be satisfied by any tier -- omit only for predicates where that is genuinely acceptable.

decision_predicates.description: Maps an outcome name (e.g. 'MERCHANT_WINS') to the head predicate a rule must derive to produce that outcome.

head.description: The predicate this rule derives when its body is satisfied.

body.description: Conjunction of literals. A literal is a predicate name, or 'not <predicate>' for negation. Negation is restricted to EDB predicates (arbiter.horn.clause's module docstring) -- negating a head predicate raises StratificationError at load time.
